purpose: Add a versioned /health endpoint that reports process uptime and git SHA
constraints: no secrets in commits or logs
public response must not expose internal hostnames
risks: health check may be scraped by load balancers — keep payload stable
acceptance: GET /health returns 200 with JSON {status, uptime_seconds, git_sha}
unit tests cover happy path and missing-git fallback
required gate checks pass on the candidate SHA with VERIFIED evidence
independent reviewer examines the exact candidate and records findings
next_increment: Implement /health with tests on feature branch
uncertainty: exact uptime source (process start vs request clock) to confirm with SRE
